executive_summary.remediation_plan:
Remediation plan for failed criteria:
- AUC below 0.75: Improve feature engineering, add more sophisticated volatility indicators, or try ensemble methods
- Precision below 0.50: Increase prediction threshold or improve model calibration
- Recall below 0.40: Decrease prediction threshold or add more sensitive features
- F1 below 0.45: Balance precision and recall by adjusting threshold or improving model performance
- Lead time below 6h: Increase forecast horizon or improve early warning features
